statement: Let M be a von Neumann algebra and k ≥ 2. (i) If f ∈ Ck b (M, M) is a cocycle, there are a separately normal bounded cocycle f0 and a bounded (k − 1)-cochain b such that f = f0 + db. (ii) If M has no type II1 central summand, then Hk b (M, M) = 0.
